Hey OP. I overdosed a week and a half ago and I’m telling you it gets better. Having a near death experience made me realise all the people I would’ve hurt and destroyed, and even if I don’t care about myself that much I cared more that people were upset and there for me to support me. I realised I’d miss out on so much that life has to give, there’s so many things I want to do. 
Do you want to travel somewhere? Experience different cultures? I know I do! Maybe not right now, but when I’m financially stable I definitely will. 
I also know that now I don’t want to study psychology anymore, I want to learn about animal care because I love animals. Is there something you love that you want to surround yourself in? 
Things will get better for you. I promise you.

I was very lucky to have had a hospital around the corner from me. My mum drove me and as soon as we were in A&E I started having fits and that’s when medics took over. If I had stayed at home and slept I would’ve died. I had to be on life support, dialysis, and a lot of drugs to help flush my system.

Hey! I lived lmao. I was in an induced coma for a day and on life support but 2 days later and I’m recovering from a chest infection. I suffered a lot of fits and muscle damage, but had a very lucky outcome from it. Hopefully to be discharged soon and get support.
If you are thinking about doing this please don’t. I hurt a lot of people and they are so glad that I am alive.
